sentences.13.2 Skal du på foreldremøte?: 13.2 Are you going to the parents' meeting?
sentences.Leyla skal hente Ismail på skolen i dag: Leyla is going to pick Ismail up from school today because he is going to the dentist.
sentences.På skolen møter hun Kari, mora til Eivin: At school she meets Kari, Eivind's mother.
sentences.Hei, Leyla! Har du lest mail? Vi har fåt: Hi, Leyla! Have you read your email? We've been invited to a parents' meeting next week. Are you going?
sentences.Jeg … jeg tror ikke at jeg skal gå fordi: I … I don't think I'll go, because the teacher talks so fast.
sentences.Men alle foreldre bør gå på foreldremøte: But all parents should go to the parents' meeting. It's important to show our children that we are interested in their school, and it's very useful because we get lots of information.
sentences.Jeg vet ikke, for jeg forstår ikke alt l: I don't know, because I don't understand everything the teacher says.
sentences.Du kan sitte sammen med meg, og jeg kan: You can sit with me, and I can explain a bit to you. It will be good for you to meet the teacher, and parents' meetings are a good way to get to know the other parents.
sentences.Da jeg gikk på barneskolen i Syria, hadd: When I went to primary school in Syria, we never had parents' meetings. What do you usually talk about at parents' meetings?
sentences.Læreren pleier å snakke om klassemiljøet: The teacher usually talks about the class environment, about plans for the year and activities they are going to have. We can also ask the teacher questions.
sentences.Ja, vi kan gå dit sammen. Det blir hygge: Yes, we can go together. It will be nice.
